hypothesis: Dependency-aware evidence groups reduce exception omission at equal payload budget
experiment: Top-k versus closure-aware selection; frozen corpus and consumer
falsification: No practically meaningful held-out improvement with predeclared confidence interval
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed

hypothesis: Qualification retention predicts useful voice answers better than bytes alone
experiment: Same evidence sets; vary retained qualifications and layout
metrics: Human-rated validity, ambiguity preservation and actionability
falsification: No incremental predictive value after controlling evidence coverage and task
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed

hypothesis: Publication-time indexes reduce request work without changing evidence identity
experiment: Same compiler and requests; prepared versus per-request indexes
metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, allocations and exact canonical output
falsification: Mismatch in output identity or no relevant workload benefit
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed

hypothesis: Core plus consumer projections improves usability without authority loss
experiment: Fixed core; JSON versus metadata-plus-readable projections
metrics: Citation support, qualification retention, payload and parse cost
falsification: No useful gains or increased unsupported conclusions
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed

hypothesis: Immutable substructure reuse is safer than semantic whole-question caching
experiment: Known equal and unequal request semantics; explicit policy changes
falsification: Any disallowed cross-view or scope reuse; negligible useful reuse
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed

hypothesis: DBOS initially adds more value to production workflows than cached reads
experiment: Simple baseline, production-only DBOS, read-miss DBOS, all-read DBOS
metrics: Recovery success, cost and tail latency under specified failures
falsification: All-read DBOS offers justified net gains at the measured workload
status: unmeasured research hypothesis; priority is proposed
